tool_description: SynthSeg is a deep learning tool for fast, contrast-agnostic segmentation of brain MRI (and optionally CT) scans. It supports robust segmentation, cortical parcellation, automated QC, and volumetric analysis, all without requiring retraining.

input.description: Path to a NIfTI MRI scan (or CT with --ct flag). This can also be a text file with paths to multiple images.

output.description: Path to the output segmentation file or a text file if input is a list.

robust.description: Use the robust model for scans with low signal-to-noise ratio or poor tissue contrast.

parc.description: Enable cortical parcellation in addition to whole-brain segmentation.

ct.description: Set to true if the input is a CT scan (Hounsfield units expected).

vol.description: Path to save volume statistics in CSV format.

qc.description: Path to save automated quality control scores in CSV format.

post.description: Path to save posterior probability maps.

resample.description: Path to save the resampled version of the input image at 1mm resolution.

cpu.description: Force the execution on CPU even if GPU is available.

threads.description: Number of threads to use for TensorFlow. Useful for CPU-based inference.

crop.description: Crop size (divisible by 32) to reduce memory load. Can be single int or 3 integers (RAS order).

fast.description: Enable fast mode that skips some operations for quicker inference with slightly reduced accuracy.

v1.description: Run the original SynthSeg (v1.0) model instead of the current version.

segmentation_file.description: Path to the output NIfTI segmentation file.

volume_statistics.description: Path to CSV file with volumes of segmented regions, if `--vol` was used.

quality_scores.description: Path to CSV file with QC scores, if `--qc` was used.

posteriors_file.description: Path to saved posterior probability maps, if `--post` was used.

resampled_image.description: Path to resampled 1mm isotropic input image, if `--resample` was used.
